submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Sb 0.4495) had the highest measured EQE (0.325%). The EQE rises from Sb 0.27 (0.116%) to a maximum near 0.45, then drops slightly at 0.48 (0.291%) and falls to about 0.017% at Sb ≥0.66. XRD shows one rutile-type pattern across Sb 0.35–0.45. Extra peaks appear by Sb 0.55, which marks the edge of the single-phase window. The best composition is inside that window.

rejected.reason: XRD shows a second phase starting; the EQE trend was already falling by 0.48
